title: AudienceCapability
description: A short-lived capability for one downstream service, audience-capability/1, obtained by a runtime from POST /internal/v1/runtime/capabilities:exchange with its control capability. For audience executor the token is the D35 HS256 compact JWS (packages/contracts/src/capability.ts); the runtime never sees the signing secret. Broker tokens carry audience broker and use the assignment ID as jti for fencing checks; services reject other audiences. Secret: never logged or stored.
